evidence.quote: The Fe–15Cr–13Co–8W–0.5Ga and Fe–22Cr–15Co–9W–0.5Ga alloys were produced in an induction furnace in argon from the components with a purity of at least 99.95%.
After a homogenizing annealing at 1473 K, the ingots were hot-forged into strip at 1000–1150°С, quenched from 1473 K, and rolled at room temperature to a reduction of 60–80%.
